scope: Frozen before final profile selection; never used in cache training or earlier candidate screens. Performance and output consistency checks, not a quality benchmark.

cases.name: fresh-dedup
cases.text: Write a Python function that removes duplicate strings from an input sequence while preserving the order of their first appearance. Do not modify the caller's list. Explain the roles of a set and a result list, include an example containing empty strings and repeated words, and state the expected time and additional space complexity. Then describe how the implementation would change if case-insensitive matching were required while retaining the original spelling of the first occurrence.

cases.name: fresh-resistors
cases.text: Explain the difference between series and parallel connections of ideal resistors using simple equations. Start with two resistors of 100 ohms and 200 ohms, find their equivalent resistance in both arrangements, and explain how current and voltage are related in each arrangement. Treat this as a purely mathematical circuit exercise with ideal components; no physical wiring or construction instructions are needed. Finish by checking the limiting case in which one of the two resistances becomes extremely large.

cases.name: fresh-library-ja
cases.text: 雨の午後、小さな図書館で返却された本から、手描きの星座のしおりが見つかる場面を書いてください。司書と近所の学生が、本を傷めずに持ち主を探す方法を相談します。人物名、場所、会話はすべて創作してください。静かな雰囲気の中で、二人の観察の仕方の違いが伝わるように、短い会話と周囲の描写を交互に入れてください。既存の小説や実在の事件は使わないでください。

cases.name: fresh-rectangle
cases.text: A fictional school has 40 meters of rope and uses all of it to outline a rectangular area. Explain how to express the area in terms of one side length, determine which rectangle has the greatest area, and justify the result without numerical search. Present both a completing-the-square explanation and a brief geometric intuition. State the allowed range of side lengths and distinguish the perimeter constraint from the area being optimized. Use exact arithmetic throughout.

cases.name: fresh-sql
cases.text: Use an invented table of workshop registrations with columns workshop_id, attendee_name, and registration_date to explain SQL GROUP BY and HAVING. Give a query that counts registrations per workshop and retains workshops with at least three registrations. Explain why the row-level condition on registration_date belongs in WHERE and the count condition belongs in HAVING. Include a small fictional table and manually show the grouped result. Do not connect to or execute commands against any database.

cases.name: fresh-plants-de
cases.text: Erkläre einer Schulklasse, wie Pflanzen Lichtenergie für die Fotosynthese nutzen. Beschreibe die Rolle von Wasser, Kohlendioxid und Chlorophyll und unterscheide die Bildung energiereicher Stoffe von der späteren Zellatmung. Verwende eine erfundene Zimmerpflanze als Beispiel und erkläre, warum die Masse einer wachsenden Pflanze nicht einfach aus dem Boden stammt. Schreibe mehrere verständliche Absätze und vermeide konkrete Pflegeempfehlungen oder Angaben zu einer bestimmten Pflanzenart.

cases.name: fresh-queue-ja
cases.text: 先入れ先出しのキューと、後入れ先出しのスタックの違いを日本語で説明してください。架空の作業依頼A、B、Cが順番に到着する例を用い、それぞれの取り出し順を示してください。基本操作、空の状態で取り出す場合の扱い、用途の例を説明し、配列と連結リストのどちらでも実装できることに触れてください。実行時間の説明では、実装方法に依存する点を区別してください。

cases.name: fresh-map-fr
cases.text: Explique en français la différence entre la distance sur une carte et la distance réelle lorsqu'une carte utilise une échelle de un pour vingt-cinq mille. Utilise un exemple fictif dans lequel deux points sont séparés de quatre centimètres sur la carte, montre chaque conversion d'unité, puis explique pourquoi la longueur d'un chemin sinueux peut dépasser la distance en ligne droite. Termine par une méthode simple pour vérifier que l'ordre de grandeur du résultat est cohérent, sans citer de lieu réel.
